verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a public Platform API with API-key onboarding, SDK calls such as client.add, and add/search operations. It also offers entity scoping, webhooks and export through the API, plus a self-hosted REST server with per-user API keys. A probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) and llms.txt, so the API is machine-discoverable for AI-native use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, and endpoint-level reference detail beyond the feature-page excerpts.
